title: Smoky German Noodle Stir-Fry
description: A quick and easy German-inspired stir-fry made with smoky noodles, shirataki noodles, and a hint of smokiness.
instructions: Cook shirataki noodles according to package instructions.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and cook the chopped onion until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the smoky noodles to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked shirataki noodles to the pan and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
If using, add German mustard and soy sauce, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
